resources.string: Add an extra layer of security to your SafeKey vault using an authenticator app.
After setup, you will need a six-digit code from your authenticator app when signing in to SafeKey.
Scan the QR code using your authenticator app, or enter the setup key manually.
Open your authenticator app and scan this QR code.
If you cannot scan the QR code, enter this key into your authenticator app.
Enter the six-digit code currently shown in your authenticator app.
An authenticator app is already configured.
Incorrect code. Check your authenticator app and try again.
Too many incorrect attempts. Start setup again.
Setup expired. Start again to generate a new key.
Unable to start authenticator setup. Please try again.
Unable to verify the code. Please try again.
Your vault session has ended. Sign in again to continue.
Authenticator setup is only available in your main vault.
Keep your setup key private. Anyone with this key may be able to generate authentication codes for your vault.
Authenticator protection is not enabled until your code is verified.
